reviews.reviewText: The place is so cute and has the most welcoming vibes!! The employees are so kind and friendly! I got my lashes done by Emily and they look so perfect I love them!! Will definitely be going back for my fill my experience was perfect!

reviews.subject: Venue
reviews.reviewText: I love Lash Pop! I have been going consistently for several years and I have always had a great experience. It’s a cute and stylish spot, very clean and relaxing. I have booked with a handful of different providers for my lashes, and they have all done an excellent job. Not only do my lashes turn out amazing but I have great retention, which is very important. Everyone is super sweet and welcoming. I can confidently book an appointment with anyone there for my lashes and know that I’ll be happy and satisfied with the results.

I’ve been getting my lashes done by Kelly at Lashpop for about 8 months, and she's hands down the best lash artist I’ve ever been to. She has an incredible eye for detail and knows exactly how to create a look that fits your face and style — whether you want soft and wispy or bold and full glam.
My lashes always come out clean, even, and long lasting. I get compliments all the time, and the quality of her work speaks for itself; they always look fresh, full, and beautifully done. The appointments are super relaxing (I usually nap), and the studio is spotless, comfortable, and has a great vibe.
Kelly is professional, easy to talk to, and truly cares about the end result. If you're in the Oceanside area and want lashes that actually last and look amazing, she’s the one. I highly recommend her!

LashPop is an absolutely beautiful studio with a wonderful, kind, sweet owner Emily. She hires fantastic estheticians who are professional, easy to talk to, and make the whole experience easy and enjoyable. I was always an "anti lash extensions" girly but after a medical incident left me no choice, I gave it a shot. I can't tell you how many compliments I get on my lashes!! Every esthetician treats me and my lashes with care and on the ONE occasion there was a scheduling misshap, they gave me a discount for the service. Lashpop is run so well, with a customer-first mentality and I hope they continue to thrive!
I am new to the area and finally found my favorite lash studio.  I will not go anywhere else. They do the best application and my lashes get many compliments. I recommend this studio highly.

So I am new to lash extensions but wanted to try them out bc Ii spend so much time in the ocean. My main concern was they wouldn't last due to exposure to salt water. Thode cincerns were unfounded!  Even after a 10 day vacation in Costa Rica my lashes looked great!  Emily did an amazing job!  My lashes looked natural but still dramatic and it was so great not wearing mascara. Emily really listened to me and fine tuned her work to meet my desired outcome. After I got back I got a fill from Paige who did an equally fantastic job!  The salon is clean, the beds are comfy, the decor it beautiful, parking is easy, the vibe is chill!  I would 100% recommend this place!  !

reviews.subject: Paige Gordon
reviews.reviewText:
I tried LashPop for the first time on Saturday and I’m seriously obsessed! The shop is so cute and welcoming, and they offer tons of services.

Paige did my lashes and WOW — she is incredibly talented. She took her time, paid attention to every detail, and gave me the most beautiful, long, natural-looking set. I can’t stop looking at them! It makes getting ready in the morning so quick and easy, and I feel put together even without makeup. Highly recommend her if you’re thinking about getting your lashes done!

Nancy has been doing my lashes for about 4 to 5 years and she recently started lashing at Lash Pop and is the BEST!!! I used to do eyelash extensions, so finding someone I trust to do my lashes can be scary. NOT WITH NANCY. She will always always always put the health of your natural lashes first. She takes her time making sure your lashes are perfectly isolated and not all globbed together (which can be soooo painful!). She also makes sure to talk with you before to get a good understanding of what kind of lashes you are wanting. Not only is she amazing at what she does, but she is extremely kind and makes appointments such a delight. I always love our conversations and have never ever felt uncomfortable on her table. I also have to add....the salon is SO CUTE. Its extremely clean and everyone is so welcoming. I definitely recommend coming here and seeing Nancy!

Rachel is amazing! I wouldn’t ever go to anyone else! I needed a very natural look and she was able to offer brown lashes and really make it so you can’t tell they are fake. They perfectly match my natural lashes which are blonde and make them fuller. Previously I had gone to Lash Away and they were so bad I had to get them redone the next day. It made me believe lashes weren’t for me and I never tried them again until now, 5 years later, and so glad I did. I never have to wear makeup or if I do it’s a tinted moisturizer and blush and it looks great.
Also Rachel is so knowledgeable on so many things beauty. I love chatting w her and the time flies by. I will be a loyal customer of Rachel for as long as I get lashes! ❤️

3007344b-e0a9-44d8-8a1f-2ee66458ba72.question: How do I book an appointment?
3007344b-e0a9-44d8-8a1f-2ee66458ba72.answer: You can easily book online by clicking the Book Now button at the top of this page then choose a service, choose a time, and request an appointment. You will receive a confirmation email and text once your appointment is approved.

3007344b-e0a9-44d8-8a1f-2ee66458ba72.question: How do I know which service to book?
3007344b-e0a9-44d8-8a1f-2ee66458ba72.answer:
Not sure which lash style fits you? Take our "lash quiz" on the homepage to find your perfect lash style.

For brows, facials, Botox, permanent jewelry, or waxing, browse our "Meet the Team" page to find your ideal provider, or call/text the LashPop line and we'll match you with a service provider we think would be the best fit for you.

3007344b-e0a9-44d8-8a1f-2ee66458ba72.question: Independent stylists vs. employees - what's the difference?
3007344b-e0a9-44d8-8a1f-2ee66458ba72.answer:
We're a hybrid salon, meaning we have both LashPop employees and independent beauty businesses renting space under our roof. Each independent service provider sets their own pricing/policies and handles their own bookings and client relationships.

Each team member has been carefully hand selected to be under the LashPop brand, so either way, you'll be in great hands whether you book with an employee or independent artist.

When you book with a specific stylist, your deposit, rescheduling, and cancellation policies follow their terms, though we aim for consistency in standards across all stylists.

3007344b-e0a9-44d8-8a1f-2ee66458ba72.question: How to Prepare for Your Appointment
3007344b-e0a9-44d8-8a1f-2ee66458ba72.answer:
• Use the restroom before your appointment.
  • Bring headphones or your own playlist if you want to zone out and relax.
  • Bring a sweater or light blanket - we keep our studio at 70-72F for certain products.
  • Plan to lay fairly still throughout the service.
  • Try to minimize talking during lash services to avoid fluttering eyes or movement that can affect application.

3007344b-e0a9-44d8-8a1f-2ee66458ba72.question: Parking & Studio Entry/Door Code
3007344b-e0a9-44d8-8a1f-2ee66458ba72.answer:
Parking: Free street parking is available all around near the studio. There is also a shared parking lot on the north end of the building.

Why we use a door code: The front door will be locked when you arrive. This helps us create a peaceful, uninterrupted environment for your service and ensures that only scheduled clients and team members have access to the studio. It's simply an extra layer of comfort and safety for both our guests and our team — while keeping out unexpected solicitors or walk-ins. :)

You will receive the door code from your stylist after booking. Be sure to save the code for your future appointments :) and reach out to your stylist if you are having any issues entering the space.

Please arrive a few minutes early and make yourself at home in our waiting area. Use the restroom and grab a complimentary coffee or tea while you wait for your stylist to come get you.

1c689e5d-b9f7-4639-a408-97b3e1ab3145.question: LashPop Studio policies: Children & Pets
1c689e5d-b9f7-4639-a408-97b3e1ab3145.answer:
• To maintain a peaceful, clean environment and ensure safety, we ask that you do not bring children under 10 or pets to your appointment.
  • If you do bring a guest, we ask that they just be mindful of our peaceful atmosphere. :)

1c689e5d-b9f7-4639-a408-97b3e1ab3145.question: Cell Phones & Courtesy
1c689e5d-b9f7-4639-a408-97b3e1ab3145.answer:
• During your service, we ask that you silence your phone to help keep our shared space a peaceful atmosphere for other guests.
  • We try to keep conversation at a soft level to allow for others to relax.

1c689e5d-b9f7-4639-a408-97b3e1ab3145.question: Policies for our Independent LP team members
1c689e5d-b9f7-4639-a408-97b3e1ab3145.answer: Each of our independent beauty businesses determine their own policies regarding deposits, payment, cancellation fees, late policies, refunds, etc. Check with your specific service provider to confirm their policies regarding your appointment if you have any questions.

1c689e5d-b9f7-4639-a408-97b3e1ab3145.question: Referral Program & Discounts
1c689e5d-b9f7-4639-a408-97b3e1ab3145.answer:
Receive $25 off with any LashPop employee if you refer a friend. Your friend will also receive $25 off their first appointment. It must be used with that specific LashPop employee.

Because our team is made up of independent stylists, each artist chooses their own client pricing, and promotions. You can always check with your service provider about any referral programs or promos.

1c689e5d-b9f7-4639-a408-97b3e1ab3145.question: Cancellation Policy
1c689e5d-b9f7-4639-a408-97b3e1ab3145.answer: Please contact your stylist directly for any appointment changes or cancellations, as each independent beauty business at our studio sets its own policies for deposits, payments, cancellation fees, late arrivals, and refunds. If you cancel within 24 to 48 hours of your appointment, you may be responsible for part or all of the service cost. If you have any questions about your appointment, please check with your specific service provider to confirm their policy.

b6ec08cf-9a9c-4e88-943c-385f7e248a11.question: What is the process and how long will they last?
b6ec08cf-9a9c-4e88-943c-385f7e248a11.answer:
Getting eyelash extensions is a simple, relaxing process. Your appointment starts with a consultation where your stylist talks through your desired look, eye shape, natural lash health, and options for style, curl, length, and color. Once your lashes are cleansed and prepped, you will lay back with your eyes closed while individual extensions are carefully applied to each of your natural lashes.

When your appointment is finished, you will leave with fuller, customized lashes and aftercare instructions to help them last as long as possible.

A full set of lashes will last 2-4 weeks, depending on your natural lash cycle, lifestyle, and how well you care for them. Because your natural lashes shed daily, your extensions will shed with them (this is completely normal). We recommend coming in for lash fills every 2-3 weeks.

b6ec08cf-9a9c-4e88-943c-385f7e248a11.question: How to Prepare
b6ec08cf-9a9c-4e88-943c-385f7e248a11.answer:
• Arrive with clean, makeup-free lashes.
  • Silence your phone.
  • Keep talking to a minimum to avoid eye movement during application.
  • Use the restroom before your appointment if needed.
  • Bring headphones and your phone if you'd like to listen to your own music or podcasts.
  • Bring a blanket or sweater (we keep our studio at 70-72 degrees for certain products).

b6ec08cf-9a9c-4e88-943c-385f7e248a11.question: Aftercare & Maintenance
b6ec08cf-9a9c-4e88-943c-385f7e248a11.answer:
• Clean lashes daily with a lash cleanser and gentle fluffy cleanser brush
  • Gently brush with a clean lash brush.
  • No mascara, eyeliner, or oil-based products on the lashes.
  • Do not use eyelash curlers or waterproof makeup around the lashes
  • Avoid rubbing, pulling, picking
  • Fills every 2–3 weeks are recommended

b6ec08cf-9a9c-4e88-943c-385f7e248a11.question: Will lash extensions damage my natural lashes?
b6ec08cf-9a9c-4e88-943c-385f7e248a11.answer:
Damage only happens if they are done incorrectly (we've got you covered here), or do not care for them properly (pulling at them, rubbing your eyes, sleeping on your face, not keeping them clean).

We are committed to best practices in application, to ensure healthy lashes for our clients! So as long as you are committed to following the simple aftercare instructions, you'll be good.

b6ec08cf-9a9c-4e88-943c-385f7e248a11.question: How often do I need to come in for fills/touchups?
Can I have an allergic reaction to lash extensions?
b6ec08cf-9a9c-4e88-943c-385f7e248a11.answer:
Unfortunately reactions can happen if you are allergic to any ingredients in the lash glue. However, we do have a sensitive glue option as an alternative.

We can always do a "mini" appointment for new clients to test if you are allergic before doing the full set.

1010bb51-a8cf-4ec8-882b-487bac7e6083.question: What is the cost?
1010bb51-a8cf-4ec8-882b-487bac7e6083.answer: We're a beauty collective, and each of our stylists is an independent professional/business, so the price of a lash lift and tint will range from $120-125 depending on the stylist.

1010bb51-a8cf-4ec8-882b-487bac7e6083.question: What is the process and how long will it last?
1010bb51-a8cf-4ec8-882b-487bac7e6083.answer: A lash lift and tint enhances your natural lashes using a two step process that lifts/curls the lashes upward to give them a longer appearance without the maintenance of lash extensions. A tint is then added to give your lashes a darker appearance. Low maintenance. Lasts 6-8 weeks.

1010bb51-a8cf-4ec8-882b-487bac7e6083.question: How to Prepare
1010bb51-a8cf-4ec8-882b-487bac7e6083.answer:
• Arrive with clean, makeup-free lashes.
  • Remove contacts if you wear them.
  • Silence your phone.
  • Keep talking to a minimum to avoid eye movement during application.
  • Use the restroom before your appointment if needed.
  • Bring headphones and your phone if you'd like to listen to your own music or podcasts.
  • Bring a blanket or sweater (we keep our studio at 70-72 degrees for certain products).

1010bb51-a8cf-4ec8-882b-487bac7e6083.question: Aftercare & Maintenance
1010bb51-a8cf-4ec8-882b-487bac7e6083.answer:
• Avoid water, steam, and makeup on lashes for 24–48 hours.
  • Use nourishing serums if desired.
  • Book this service 6-8 weeks apart to avoid over-processing.

1010bb51-a8cf-4ec8-882b-487bac7e6083.question: Will lash lifts damage my natural lashes?
1010bb51-a8cf-4ec8-882b-487bac7e6083.answer: When done professionally, lash lifts are gentle and safe.

d6f737a8-adf6-4843-95c7-7bf22aa3f863.question: Which brow services do you offer?
d6f737a8-adf6-4843-95c7-7bf22aa3f863.answer: We offer brow laminations, brow tinting, brow waxing, microblading and nanobrows.

d6f737a8-adf6-4843-95c7-7bf22aa3f863.question: What is the cost?
d6f737a8-adf6-4843-95c7-7bf22aa3f863.answer: We're a beauty collective, and each of our stylists is an independent professional/business, so the price of our brow services will vary depending on the stylist. Check out the services or book now section for specific brow pricing.

d6f737a8-adf6-4843-95c7-7bf22aa3f863.question: Appointment Lengths
d6f737a8-adf6-4843-95c7-7bf22aa3f863.answer:
• Brow Lamination + Tint: 45 - 60 mins
  • Brow Lamination: 45 mins
  • Brow Tint: 15 mins
  • Brow Wax/Shaping: 15 - 30 mins
  • Microblading: See Microblading and PMU FAQ section
  • Nanobrows: See Microblading and PMU FAQ section

d6f737a8-adf6-4843-95c7-7bf22aa3f863.question: What is the process and how long will they last?
d6f737a8-adf6-4843-95c7-7bf22aa3f863.answer:
Brow Lamination and Tint: A Brow Lamination gives your brows a set, uniform shape for 6-8 weeks. This treatment relaxes your brow hair so you're able to manipulate the hair in a more desirable shape of your choice, and give you a bolder/fuller brow.

Brow Wax/Shaping: A brow wax and shaping appointment is a quick, simple service designed to clean up and define your brows. Your stylist will assess your natural brow shape, discuss your goals, and carefully remove unwanted hair to create a more balanced, polished look that complements your features.

Microblading: See Microblading & PMU FAQ section

Nanobrows: See Microblading & PMU FAQ section

d6f737a8-adf6-4843-95c7-7bf22aa3f863.question: How to Prepare
d6f737a8-adf6-4843-95c7-7bf22aa3f863.answer:
Brow Lamination + Tint: Avoid using retinol, exfoliants, and active skincare around the brow area for 5 - 7 days beforehand to prevent sensitivity. Do not wax, tweeze, or trim your brows prior to your appointment, as your artist will shape them as needed. Arrive with clean, dry brows free of makeup, oils, or skincare, and avoid using oil-based products leading up to your service to ensure the best results. It's also important to avoid sunburn or any irritation in the brow area before your appointment.

Brow Wax/Shaping: Come with clean make-up free brows. Let your brows grow out for 2–3 weeks for the best shape. Avoid sun exposure or tanning before your appointment. Skip strong exfoliants or acne treatments near the brow area. Avoid using oil-based products around the brows before your appointment.

Microblading: See Microblading and PMU FAQ section

Nanobrows: See Microblading and PMU FAQ section

General Preparation: Silence your phone. Use the restroom before your appointment if needed. Bring headphones and your phone if you'd like to listen to your own music or podcasts. Bring a blanket or sweater (we keep our studio at 70-72 degrees for certain products).

d6f737a8-adf6-4843-95c7-7bf22aa3f863.question: Aftercare
d6f737a8-adf6-4843-95c7-7bf22aa3f863.answer:
Brow Wax Aftercare: Expect slight redness, this is normal and should subside within a few hours. Avoid makeup, sweating, and sun exposure for 24 hours. Do not use retinol, exfoliants, or active skincare on the area for 2–3 days. Apply a soothing gel (like aloe) if needed.

Brow Lamination + Tint Aftercare: Keep your brows completely dry for 24 hours, avoid cleansing, scrubbing, steam, sweating, saunas, makeup, and skincare around the brow area, skip oil-based products to help the tint last longer, expect the color to soften slightly over the first few days, and brush your brows daily while using a nourishing oil or serum to keep them healthy.

Microblading Aftercare: See Microblading & PMU FAQ section

Nanobrows Aftercare: See Microblading & PMU FAQ section

2da44bab-7670-4856-ac66-fbbe271c7ca2.question: What is the process?
2da44bab-7670-4856-ac66-fbbe271c7ca2.answer:
Both facials and Hydrafacials begin with a skin consultation, followed by a treatment designed to cleanse, exfoliate, and hydrate your skin.

A custom facial typically includes cleansing, exfoliation, extractions (if needed), a targeted mask, and finishing products to leave your skin refreshed and glowing.

A Hydrafacial uses advanced technology to deeply cleanse, extract impurities, and infuse the skin with hydrating serums for instant, noticeable results.

2da44bab-7670-4856-ac66-fbbe271c7ca2.question: What is the cost?
2da44bab-7670-4856-ac66-fbbe271c7ca2.answer: We're a beauty collective, and each of our stylists is an independent professional/business, so the price of our skincare and facial services will vary depending on the stylist. Check out the services or book now section for specific skincare and facial pricing.

2da44bab-7670-4856-ac66-fbbe271c7ca2.question: How to Prepare
2da44bab-7670-4856-ac66-fbbe271c7ca2.answer:
• Arrive with clean make-up and product free skin.
  • Avoid exfoliating products (including shaving and waxing), Retin-A, Tretinoin, and Benzoyl Peroxide for at least five days prior.
  • Avoid tanning or sunburn for at least 48 hours before.
  • Shave the day before (if needed), not the same day.
  • Stay hydrated!
  • Silence your phone.
  • Use the restroom before your appointment if needed.
  • Bring headphones and your phone if you'd like to listen to your own music or podcasts.
  • Bring a blanket or sweater (we keep our studio at 70-72 degrees for certain products).

2da44bab-7670-4856-ac66-fbbe271c7ca2.question: Aftercare
2da44bab-7670-4856-ac66-fbbe271c7ca2.answer:
• Avoid touching your face or applying makeup for at least 6 hours.
  • Skip workouts, saunas, or hot showers for 24 hours.
  • No exfoliation, retinol, or strong actives for 3–5 days after.
  • Use gentle cleansers and moisturizers only for the first couple of days.
  • Always wear SPF 30+ daily.
  • Avoid tanning or direct sun for at least 72 hours.
  • Hydrate well.

9919c87a-36f5-42dc-9c62-c8f2ab8cedb0.question: Appointment Lengths
9919c87a-36f5-42dc-9c62-c8f2ab8cedb0.answer: Brows: 20-30 minsFace: 30 minUpper lip: 15 minChin: 15 minLegs: 30-45 minFull arms: 45 minHalf arms: 30 minUnderarm: 30 minBrazilian: 45 min

9919c87a-36f5-42dc-9c62-c8f2ab8cedb0.question: How to Prepare
9919c87a-36f5-42dc-9c62-c8f2ab8cedb0.answer:
• Let hair grow to at least ¼ inch.
  • Avoid sun exposure, tanning, or aggressive exfoliants (like retinol or acids) for 24–48 hours before.
  • The Day Of: Arrive with clean, dry skin (no lotions/oils). Avoid excess caffeine/alcohol. Wear loose-fitting clothing.
  • Silence your phone.
  • Use the restroom before your appointment if needed.
  • Bring headphones and your phone if you'd like to listen to your own music or podcasts.
  • Bring a blanket or sweater (we keep our studio at 70-72 degrees for certain products).

9919c87a-36f5-42dc-9c62-c8f2ab8cedb0.question: What is the Process?
9919c87a-36f5-42dc-9c62-c8f2ab8cedb0.answer:
Your waxing appointment begins with a quick consultation to review your skin and desired results. The area is then cleansed and prepped before your esthetician carefully removes unwanted hair using professional-grade wax.

After the wax, a soothing product is applied to calm the skin and reduce any redness or irritation.

9919c87a-36f5-42dc-9c62-c8f2ab8cedb0.question: Aftercare
9919c87a-36f5-42dc-9c62-c8f2ab8cedb0.answer:
• Avoid heat, sweat, and tight clothing for 24 hrs.
  • Exfoliate gently 2–3 days post-wax to prevent ingrowns.
  • Moisturize daily.
  • Do not shave or tweeze between wax appointments.
  • Book waxes regularly every 4–6 weeks for best results.

d7bdad4f-4e07-48a5-b870-b89efcb40851.question: What is the cost?
d7bdad4f-4e07-48a5-b870-b89efcb40851.answer: We're a beauty collective, and each of our stylists is an independent professional/business, so the price of our microblading/nanobrows and PMU services will vary depending on the stylist. Check out the services or book now section for specific microblading/nanobrows and permanent make-up pricing.

d7bdad4f-4e07-48a5-b870-b89efcb40851.question: Appointment Lengths
d7bdad4f-4e07-48a5-b870-b89efcb40851.answer:
• Microblading / Nano Brows initial appointment: 2–4 hours
  • Touch-Ups: 1–2 hours

d7bdad4f-4e07-48a5-b870-b89efcb40851.question: What is the Process?
d7bdad4f-4e07-48a5-b870-b89efcb40851.answer: Each appointment begins with a consultation and custom design, including shape and color selection. Once approved, pigment is carefully implanted into the skin using precise techniques. A perfecting touch-up is scheduled at 6–8 weeks for best results.

d7bdad4f-4e07-48a5-b870-b89efcb40851.question: How to Prepare
d7bdad4f-4e07-48a5-b870-b89efcb40851.answer:
• Avoid alcohol, caffeine, and blood thinners 24 hours before
  • Do not take ibuprofen or aspirin prior to your service
  • Avoid retinol, exfoliants, and active skincare in the brow area for 5–7 days before
  • No sunburn, tanning, or facials at least 1 week prior
  • Arrive with clean skin and no make-up
  • Silence your phone.
  • Use the restroom before your appointment if needed.
  • Bring headphones and your phone if you'd like to listen to your own music or podcasts.
  • Bring a blanket or sweater (we keep our studio at 70-72 degrees for certain products).

d7bdad4f-4e07-48a5-b870-b89efcb40851.question: Aftercare
d7bdad4f-4e07-48a5-b870-b89efcb40851.answer:
• Keep brows clean and dry for the first 7-10 days.
  • Avoid sweating, steam, swimming, and excessive heat for the first 7-10 days.
  • Apply healing ointment as directed by your artist.
  • Do not pick, scratch, or rub the area, allow any flaking to shed naturally.
  • Avoid applying makeup, skincare, or sunscreen directly on the brows.
  • Avoid sun exposure, tanning, and facials while healing.
  • Expect light flaking, scabbing, and lightening of color.

a435e958-3c34-48b6-aea7-d5c23cd92f22.question: What is permanent jewelry?
a435e958-3c34-48b6-aea7-d5c23cd92f22.answer: Jewelry without a clasp! Kelly at Junie Jewelry Co. will weld your custom piece directly onto your wrist, ankle, or neck, so you can flaunt your forever jewelry, forever!

a435e958-3c34-48b6-aea7-d5c23cd92f22.question: How long does it take?
a435e958-3c34-48b6-aea7-d5c23cd92f22.answer: Take your time picking out your custom chain + charm combination, but the weld itself takes under a second! Low effort, high reward. (Appointment length: 10-20 min per piece)

a435e958-3c34-48b6-aea7-d5c23cd92f22.question: Does it hurt?
a435e958-3c34-48b6-aea7-d5c23cd92f22.answer: Not a bit! The weld is completely safe, but we also use a protective piece of leather between your skin and the spark just as an extra precaution!

a435e958-3c34-48b6-aea7-d5c23cd92f22.question: How long does it last?
a435e958-3c34-48b6-aea7-d5c23cd92f22.answer: Your weld should last until you're ready to remove it, unless it gets caught on something and breaks (in which case, we can re-weld it at one of our pop ups). To help your jewelry last as long as possible: be careful when doing activities that may tug on your jewelry and wash it regularly with soap and warm water to keep that shine!

a435e958-3c34-48b6-aea7-d5c23cd92f22.question: Can my jewelry go through airport security?
a435e958-3c34-48b6-aea7-d5c23cd92f22.answer: Yes! You shouldn't experience any issues with TSA.

a435e958-3c34-48b6-aea7-d5c23cd92f22.question: What if I need to remove my permanent jewelry?
a435e958-3c34-48b6-aea7-d5c23cd92f22.answer: You can carefully use a pair of wire cutters to cut your bracelet off when you are ready to part with your piece. Pro tip: cut it at the jump ring that connects your chain and bring it back later to one of our pop ups to re-weld it!

81fcc639-575a-4e33-a4e0-a2a1b1644f2b.question: How to Prepare
81fcc639-575a-4e33-a4e0-a2a1b1644f2b.answer:
• Avoid alcohol and blood thinners 24 hrs prior.
  • Arrive with clean skin.
  • 3-7 Days Before: Avoid blood-thinning medications/supplements if medically safe. Pause active skincare. Stay hydrated. Avoid tanning/sunburns.
  • Day of: Arrive with clean skin. Avoid excess caffeine or alcohol.

81fcc639-575a-4e33-a4e0-a2a1b1644f2b.question: Aftercare
81fcc639-575a-4e33-a4e0-a2a1b1644f2b.answer:
• No laying down, exercise, or massaging the area for 24 hrs.
  • Avoid heat or facials for 2 weeks post-treatment
  • First 4-6 Hours: Stay upright. Avoid rubbing/touching. Keep head elevated. Avoid strenuous exercise.
  • First 24 Hours: No makeup/facials/massages. Avoid alcohol. Keep area clean.
  • First 2 Weeks: Botox takes 3-14 days to settle. Minor swelling is normal. Continue gentle skincare.

featuredItems.question: How do I book an appointment?
featuredItems.answer: You can easily book online by clicking the Book Now button at the top of this page then choose a service, choose a time, and request an appointment. You will receive a confirmation email and text once your appointment is approved.

featuredItems.question: How do I know which service to book?
featuredItems.answer:
Not sure which lash style fits you? Take our "lash quiz" on the homepage to find your perfect lash style.

For brows, facials, Botox, permanent jewelry, or waxing, browse our "Meet the Team" page to find your ideal provider, or call/text the LashPop line and we'll match you with a service provider we think would be the best fit for you.

featuredItems.question: Independent stylists vs. employees - what's the difference?
featuredItems.answer:
We're a hybrid salon, meaning we have both LashPop employees and independent beauty businesses renting space under our roof. Each independent service provider sets their own pricing/policies and handles their own bookings and client relationships.

Each team member has been carefully hand selected to be under the LashPop brand, so either way, you'll be in great hands whether you book with an employee or independent artist.

When you book with a specific stylist, your deposit, rescheduling, and cancellation policies follow their terms, though we aim for consistency in standards across all stylists.

featuredItems.question: How to Prepare for Your Appointment
featuredItems.answer:
• Use the restroom before your appointment.
  • Bring headphones or your own playlist if you want to zone out and relax.
  • Bring a sweater or light blanket - we keep our studio at 70-72F for certain products.
  • Plan to lay fairly still throughout the service.
  • Try to minimize talking during lash services to avoid fluttering eyes or movement that can affect application.

featuredItems.question: Parking & Studio Entry/Door Code
featuredItems.answer:
Parking: Free street parking is available all around near the studio. There is also a shared parking lot on the north end of the building.

Why we use a door code: The front door will be locked when you arrive. This helps us create a peaceful, uninterrupted environment for your service and ensures that only scheduled clients and team members have access to the studio. It's simply an extra layer of comfort and safety for both our guests and our team — while keeping out unexpected solicitors or walk-ins. :)

You will receive the door code from your stylist after booking. Be sure to save the code for your future appointments :) and reach out to your stylist if you are having any issues entering the space.

Please arrive a few minutes early and make yourself at home in our waiting area. Use the restroom and grab a complimentary coffee or tea while you wait for your stylist to come get you.

featuredItems.question: LashPop Studio policies: Children & Pets
featuredItems.answer:
• To maintain a peaceful, clean environment and ensure safety, we ask that you do not bring children under 10 or pets to your appointment.
  • If you do bring a guest, we ask that they just be mindful of our peaceful atmosphere. :)

featuredItems.question: Cell Phones & Courtesy
featuredItems.answer:
• During your service, we ask that you silence your phone to help keep our shared space a peaceful atmosphere for other guests.
  • We try to keep conversation at a soft level to allow for others to relax.

featuredItems.question: Policies for our Independent LP team members
featuredItems.answer: Each of our independent beauty businesses determine their own policies regarding deposits, payment, cancellation fees, late policies, refunds, etc. Check with your specific service provider to confirm their policies regarding your appointment if you have any questions.

featuredItems.question: Referral Program & Discounts
featuredItems.answer:
Receive $25 off with any LashPop employee if you refer a friend. Your friend will also receive $25 off their first appointment. It must be used with that specific LashPop employee.

Because our team is made up of independent stylists, each artist chooses their own client pricing, and promotions. You can always check with your service provider about any referral programs or promos.

featuredItems.question: Cancellation Policy
featuredItems.answer: Please contact your stylist directly for any appointment changes or cancellations, as each independent beauty business at our studio sets its own policies for deposits, payments, cancellation fees, late arrivals, and refunds. If you cancel within 24 to 48 hours of your appointment, you may be responsible for part or all of the service cost. If you have any questions about your appointment, please check with your specific service provider to confirm their policy.

featuredItems.question: What is the cost?
featuredItems.answer: We're a beauty collective, and each of our stylists is an independent professional/business, so pricing depends on the stylist and which style of lashes you want. A full set will range from $150-$250 depending on those factors and fills will range from $75-$120.

featuredItems.question: What is the process and how long will they last?
featuredItems.answer:
Getting eyelash extensions is a simple, relaxing process. Your appointment starts with a consultation where your stylist talks through your desired look, eye shape, natural lash health, and options for style, curl, length, and color. Once your lashes are cleansed and prepped, you will lay back with your eyes closed while individual extensions are carefully applied to each of your natural lashes.

When your appointment is finished, you will leave with fuller, customized lashes and aftercare instructions to help them last as long as possible.

A full set of lashes will last 2-4 weeks, depending on your natural lash cycle, lifestyle, and how well you care for them. Because your natural lashes shed daily, your extensions will shed with them (this is completely normal). We recommend coming in for lash fills every 2-3 weeks.

featuredItems.question: How to Prepare
featuredItems.answer:
• Arrive with clean, makeup-free lashes.
  • Silence your phone.
  • Keep talking to a minimum to avoid eye movement during application.
  • Use the restroom before your appointment if needed.
  • Bring headphones and your phone if you'd like to listen to your own music or podcasts.
  • Bring a blanket or sweater (we keep our studio at 70-72 degrees for certain products).

featuredItems.question: Aftercare & Maintenance
featuredItems.answer:
• Clean lashes daily with a lash cleanser and gentle fluffy cleanser brush
  • Gently brush with a clean lash brush.
  • No mascara, eyeliner, or oil-based products on the lashes.
  • Do not use eyelash curlers or waterproof makeup around the lashes
  • Avoid rubbing, pulling, picking
  • Fills every 2–3 weeks are recommended

featuredItems.question: Will lash extensions damage my natural lashes?
featuredItems.answer:
Damage only happens if they are done incorrectly (we've got you covered here), or do not care for them properly (pulling at them, rubbing your eyes, sleeping on your face, not keeping them clean).

We are committed to best practices in application, to ensure healthy lashes for our clients! So as long as you are committed to following the simple aftercare instructions, you'll be good.

featuredItems.question: How often do I need to come in for fills/touchups?
Can I have an allergic reaction to lash extensions?
featuredItems.answer:
Unfortunately reactions can happen if you are allergic to any ingredients in the lash glue. However, we do have a sensitive glue option as an alternative.

We can always do a "mini" appointment for new clients to test if you are allergic before doing the full set.
